row.notes: Rebuilds the pause-menu option list: clears the VM list node at *(self+0x1088)+0x410 and the tile vector at +0x3f0/+0x3f8/+0x400, then for each of 24 option ids reads the availability byte self+0x278+id, mirrors it to the bool prop at *(self+0x1088)+0xf0+id*0x20, and for available ids creates a tile with props index and label (label from FUN_142bc52a0(self,id)). Ids 7 and 10 use template pause_options_toggle with data_array/selection bound to #settings.ghost_cars_osq / #settings.current_settings.ghost_cars_osq and #settings.use_camera / #settings.current_settings.use_camera; all other ids use pause_options_button. Restores the selection to the tile whose id equals self+0x10c4 (else first tile, updating +0x10c4), sets self+0x10c8 = any tile exists, and dispatches a UI event. Flip bytes at self+0x278.. to show or hide pause options.
